title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 402) reviews: Fayose’s kidnapping allegation sparks backlash

content.rendered:
Former Ekiti State governor Ayo Fayose has come under fire after alleging that Oyo State governor Seyi Makinde orchestrated the abduction of schoolchildren and teachers in Oyo State for political reasons.

The claim triggered widespread criticism online, responses from Governor Makinde’s camp, and even public disagreement from Fayose’s brother, as Nigerians debated the line between political criticism and serious allegations requiring evidence.
